citation.title: Acute beetroot juice supplementation, Wingate test performance and muscle oxygenation in male football players

reported.what: blood lactate before the Wingate test, placebo arm, mean ± SD, drawn 2.5 h after an undescribed blackcurrant placebo drink and an undescribed last meal (not a fasting sample)
blood lactate immediately after the Wingate test, placebo arm, mean ± SD
blood lactate 3 min after the Wingate test, placebo arm, mean ± SD
mean heart rate during the Wingate test, placebo arm, mean ± SD

detail: The warm-up before the 30-s Wingate test (5 min of light cycling at a self-chosen workload, then 3 min at 2 kgf with 5-s maximal sprints each minute) has no printed power or oxygen uptake, the placebo drink is only called low-calorie blackcurrant juice with no grams, and the last meal before the visit is not described; Table 1 (muscle oxygenation) and Table 2 (glucose, blood pressure) are images with no text in the XML, so no fasting value is available either.
